title: SWE-Lancer: Can Frontier LLMs Earn $1 Million from Real-World Freelance Software Engineering?
authors_zh: Samuel Miserendino, Michele Wang, Tejal Patwardhan, Johannes Heidecke
paper_type_zh: 真实自由职业软件工程任务的可执行与决策评测基准
best_for_zh: 需要把代码执行结果和真实工程决策联系起来评测智能体的研究者。
one_line: SWE-Lancer evaluates agents on more than 1,400 real freelance engineering tasks using triple-verified tests or the original manager's hiring choice.
SWE-Lancer 以 1,400 余项真实自由职业软件任务评测智能体，独立工程任务由三重核验测试判分，管理任务对照原始经理选择。
why: It evaluates practical engineering work through executable task contracts or the decisions that originally allocated the work.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Lancer connects real software work to executable task outcomes and manager-choice supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing software-engineering benchmarks mostly extract short-term fixes from open-source issues and omit real client constraints, commercial value, and project-management decisions. Their resolution rates therefore have no direct economic interpretation. Real freelance projects also include multi-week feature development, ambiguous requirements, existing codebases, and proposal selection. Unit tests or synthetic exercises alone cannot show whether a model can complete work for which customers actually paid.

SWE-Lancer collects more than 1,400 completed Upwork tasks with roughly USD 1 million in real payouts, covering both independent engineering work and managerial selection among technical proposals. For the public SWE-Lancer Diamond split, the paper provides a unified Docker environment and engineer-reviewed evaluation criteria, allowing model performance to be mapped to completed tasks and their associated economic value.

现有软件工程基准多从开源 issue 中抽取短期修复任务，缺少真实客户约束、商业价值和项目管理决策，因此模型解决率难以直接解释为经济能力。真实自由职业项目还包括数周功能开发、模糊需求、已有代码库和方案选择；若只用单元测试或合成题，无法判断模型能否完成市场实际付费的工作。

SWE-Lancer 从 Upwork 收集超过 1,400 个已完成任务，总真实报酬约 100 万美元，既包括独立编码任务，也包括经理在多个技术方案中做选择的管理任务。论文为公开子集 SWE-Lancer Diamond 构造统一 Docker 环境和经工程师复核的评测标准，用于把模型表现映射到可完成任务及对应经济价值。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SWE-Lancer’s main contribution is to convert real paid software projects into reproducible evaluation objects while preserving their dollar values. Independent tasks range from USD 50 bug fixes to USD 32,000 feature implementations and are judged by end-to-end tests triple-verified by experienced software engineers. Managerial tasks ask models to choose among implementation proposals, using the decision of the manager originally hired for the project as the label. The public Diamond split, unified container, and evaluation scripts enable partial reproduction. The release is primarily an economically grounded benchmark rather than a large open trajectory-training dataset.

SWE-Lancer 的核心贡献是把真实付费软件任务转化为可复现实验对象，并保留每项工作的美元价值。独立任务从 50 美元 bug fix 到 32,000 美元功能实现，使用端到端测试判定提交；测试由三名有经验的软件工程师交叉验证。管理任务要求模型在候选实现方案间选择，标签来自原项目中实际受雇经理的决定。公开的 Diamond split、统一容器和评测脚本让研究者可复跑部分任务。该数据主要是经济相关 benchmark，而非用于大规模训练的开放轨迹集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect authentic projects: Completed Upwork contracts are organized into task descriptions, code assets, delivered results, and actual payments. Projects without usable rights, code, or replayability are removed.
  1. Separate task types: Independent engineering tasks require direct code modification, whereas managerial tasks preserve candidate technical proposals and the original manager’s choice, creating execution and decision samples.
  1. Build executable evaluation: Dependencies and Docker environments are reconstructed for independent tasks. End-to-end tests are written and triple-verified by engineers to distinguish correct from incorrect implementations.
  1. Score performance and value: Independent tasks are graded by tests, managerial tasks by decision agreement, and payouts of completed tasks are aggregated. The Diamond split is public, while all private project assets are not released.

1. 收集真实项目： 从 Upwork 已完成合同中整理任务描述、代码资产、交付结果和实际付款，去除无法授权、缺少代码或不可重放的项目。
  1. 划分任务类型： 独立工程任务要求直接修改代码；管理任务保留候选技术提案与原经理选择，分别形成执行型和决策型样本。
  1. 构建执行评测： 为独立任务恢复依赖与 Docker 环境，编写覆盖端到端行为的测试，并由三名工程师验证测试能区分正确和错误实现。
  1. 计算成绩与价值： 独立任务按测试结果、管理任务按选择一致性评分，再将成功任务对应报酬求和。公开 Diamond split 供复现，完整私有资产不全部开放。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The benchmark’s strongest evidence is authentic transaction provenance and independent evaluation contracts. More than 1,400 jobs account for about USD 1 million in payouts, with task values ranging from USD 50 to USD 32,000. End-to-end tests for independent tasks are triple-verified by engineers, and managerial labels come from actual project-manager choices. Experiments with frontier models show that no model solves the majority of tasks and that dollar-denominated completion does not mirror short-code benchmark scores. This supports the claim that current models cannot replace most freelance engineering work, but Diamond is only a public subset and results depend on tools, time, and inference budgets.

基准的主要证据是任务具有真实成交记录和独立验证合同：超过 1,400 项工作累计支付约 100 万美元，价格从 50 到 32,000 美元；独立任务的端到端测试经三名工程师复核，管理标签来自实际经理选择。对前沿模型的实验显示，没有模型能解决多数任务，且按美元计算的完成价值与传统短代码分数并不等价。该结果支持“当前模型仍难替代真实自由职业工程”，但公开 Diamond 只是完整集合的子集，结论也受 agent 工具、时间和推理预算影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SWE-bench converts authentic GitHub issues into patch evaluations but lacks client payouts, managerial choices, and the value of multi-week projects. HumanEval-style tasks contain even less repository and commercial context. SWE-Lancer does not introduce a fundamentally new testing framework; it changes the sampling unit to completed freelance contracts and preserves actual payment as an evaluation dimension. It also places code implementation and proposal selection in one benchmark. The novelty is therefore task provenance and economic measurement: models receive not only pass/fail outcomes but an estimate of real market value completed.

SWE-bench 将真实 GitHub issue 转为补丁评测，但没有客户付款、管理选择或跨周项目价值；HumanEval 一类题目更缺少完整仓库和商业上下文。SWE-Lancer 的变化不是采用新的测试框架，而是以已成交自由职业合同作为采样单位，并把实际报酬保留为评价维度。同时，它把“写代码”和“选择实施方案”放入同一 benchmark。因而新意在任务来源和经济测量面：模型不只获得 pass/fail，还可计算其完成了多少真实市场价值。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Public-release boundary: Client code, contracts, and privacy constraints prevent release of all 1,400-plus tasks, and Diamond may not match the full set’s domain or difficulty distribution. Researchers must state the split used.
  1. Payout is not pure difficulty: Prices also reflect negotiation, geography, timing, and client budgets, so dollars cannot be treated directly as technical difficulty or productivity. Task count, type, and value should be reported together.
  1. Evaluation proxies: Triple verification improves reliability, but complex requirements may remain untested. Agreement with the original manager also does not prove that a proposal is objectively optimal. High-value conclusions need human review.

1. 公开边界： 客户代码、合同和隐私限制使完整 1,400 余任务不能全部开放，Diamond 的难度与领域分布可能不代表全集。研究者应明确报告使用 split。
  1. 报酬非纯难度： 价格还受谈判、地区、时间和客户预算影响，不能把美元直接当作技术难度或生产率。宜同时报告任务数、类型和价值。
  1. 测试代理： 三重验证提高可靠性，但复杂功能可能存在未覆盖需求；管理任务与原经理一致也不保证该方案客观最优。高价值结论需结合人工复审。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Economic-capability evaluation: Fix tools, time, and token budgets on Diamond and report independent-task success, managerial-choice accuracy, and total dollar value of completed tasks.
  1. Agent comparison: Compare plain LLMs, terminal-equipped agents, and systems with human clarification to determine whether bottlenecks arise from coding, requirement understanding, or project planning.
  1. Data-construction reference: Build analogous internal benchmarks from historical enterprise tickets using real cost, executable acceptance, and human review. If code cannot be released or dependencies reconstructed, the result may support internal audits but should not be described as a reproducible public dataset.

1. 经济能力评测： 在 Diamond 上固定工具、时间和 token 预算，报告独立任务通过率、管理选择准确率及成功任务美元总额。
  1. Agent 对照： 比较纯 LLM、具备终端工具的 agent 和有人类澄清渠道的系统，分析能力瓶颈来自代码、需求理解还是项目规划。
  1. 数据构建参考： 为企业内部历史工单建立类似“真实成本—可执行验收—人工复核”基准。若无法公开代码或重建依赖，可用于内部审计，但不应声称形成可复现公开数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-Lancer uses real Upwork contracts and payouts to measure how much market software work models can complete.
  2. Method takeaway: Project filtering, independent/managerial task separation, triple engineer verification, and value mapping are essential.
  3. Data takeaway: The full set has over 1,400 tasks worth about USD 1 million; public Diamond provides a unified Docker image and evaluation scripts.
  4. Evidence anchor: Frontier models still fail the majority of tasks, within the boundary of the public subset and inference budgets.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits economic-impact evaluation, but dollars must not be equated with technical difficulty and should accompany task-level success reports.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-Lancer 用真实 Upwork 合同和付款衡量模型能完成多少市场软件工作。
  2. 方法抓手： 项目筛选、独立/管理任务划分、工程师三重测试验证和价值映射是关键。
  3. 数据抓手： 全集超过 1,400 任务、总值约 100 万美元；公开 Diamond 提供统一 Docker 与评测脚本。
  4. 证据锚点： 前沿模型仍无法解决多数任务，但成绩受公开子集和推理预算限制。
  5. 复用决定： 适合经济影响评测；不能把美元等同技术难度，必须同时报告任务类型和通过率。
